data.body: **[P2] Preserve the existing call signature.** Making this argument required breaks keyword callers that omit it, while an existing positional `output_dir` argument now binds as the timeout, potentially suppressing history output or causing arithmetic errors during log polling. The retriever similarly no longer accepts its previous two-client construction. Keep `output_dir` in its original position, append this parameter with a `120.0` default, and give `CloudWatchLogRetriever` the same default.
